description: Initial baseline: LightGBM with native categorical handling
Iteration 1: EV domain features (total charging, commute/station, income/car, unmitigated anxiety, subsidy synergy)
Iteration 2: Affordability x Concern interactions (Income*Env, Income/Age, log1p_income) + num_leaves=63
Iteration 3: Group aggregations (City_Type, Car_Type income/commute diffs) + LightGBM (0.65) / XGBoost (0.35) blend
Iteration 4: Percentile Rank-Normalized Blending (0.60 LGBM + 0.40 XGBoost) with Group Aggregations
Iteration 5: Strict in-fold frequency encoding (Income, Commute, Age) + Percentile Rank Blending (0.60 LGB + 0.40 XGB)
Iteration 6: XGBoost-dominant rank blending (0.45 LGB + 0.55 XGB) with in-fold frequency encoding
Iteration 7: LightGBM tuned leaves=40, min_child_samples=30 within 0.45 LGB + 0.55 XGB rank blend
Iteration 8: XGBoost tuned lr=0.085, n_estimators=380 + LightGBM leaves=40, mcs=30 rank blend
Iteration 9: Full convergence budget (LGBM n_est=650, XGB n_est=550, early_stopping=35) with 0.50/0.50 rank blend
Iteration 10: High-resolution histogram bins (LGBM max_bin=1024, XGBoost max_bin=2048) with 0.50/0.50 rank blend
Iteration 11: Ultra-high-resolution XGBoost (max_bin=4096, weight=0.65) + LightGBM (max_bin=1024, weight=0.35)
Iteration 12: XGB max_depth=5 max_bin=4096 + LGB leaves=36 (REVERTED: 138.09s exceeded strict 120s budget)
Iteration 12b: LGB colsample=0.95 + XGB gamma=0.05 (REVERTED: 134.43s exceeded strict 120s budget)
Iteration 13: Asymmetric XGB (depth=5, bin=4096, lr=0.092) + LGB (leaves=36, bin=1024, lr=0.088) (REVERTED: 126.19s exceeded strict 120s budget by 6.19s)
Iteration 13: Asymmetric fast Depth-5 XGBoost (max_bin=4096, lr=0.092, n=410, w=0.62) + LightGBM (leaves=36, lr=0.089, n=450, max_bin=1024, w=0.38)

Iteration 14: Asymmetric ensemble - Depth-5 ultra-high-res XGBoost (max_bin=4096, lr=0.092, eval_metric=logloss, net_green_subsidy + sub_x_inc, w=0.62) + LightGBM (leaves=36, lr=0.088, max_bin=1024, w=0.38)
